rule.title: Only state and local income taxes paid in 2025 reach Schedule A line 5a

when_missing.because: A tax on the 2025 record was paid in 2025 unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: State and local income taxes paid in 2025 for a prior year, such as taxes paid with your 2024 state or local income tax return.

rule.open_point: Penalties and interest are not taxes; an item that is one is the preparer's to remove.
